avis.titre: 100% best body firming cream for me
avis.texte: I love the results Nuxe products give and this skin firming range is a must for the whole body. It's not greasy very easy to absorb. One pump is enough for both my arms, 3 pumps per leg and 2 pumps split between stomach and rear end. Leaves you feeling refreshed and fragrance reminds me of when spa treatments were in my budget. I use this body treatment lotion at night. I team this up with Nuxe body wash (which ever is to hand) daily and the regular Nuxe body lotion in the morning. If going out or on holiday I use their SPF 30 sun oil and/or creams with the aftersun (if on hols) in the evenings. Why did you choose this product over others?: Nuxe deliver results, their products are excellent quality and suit my skin. From brief looks at their company ethics they are eco friendly and sustainable. Scent: Lovely refreshing "spa" fragrance
